derivation: from a compound of G5469 (χαλινός) and the reduplicated form of G71 (ἄγω);
def: to be a bit-leader, i.e. to curb (figuratively)

occurrences.text: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
